brief_title: Efficacy and Safety of a Fixed or a Flexible Supplementary Insulin Therapy in Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: Efficacy and Safety of Insulin Aspart in a Fixed or Flexible Supplementary Insulin Therapy Regimen, With or Without Insulin Detemir in Type 2 Diabetes
brief_summary: This trial is conducted in Europe. This trial aims for a comparison of the efficacy and safety of Insulin Aspart, given in a fixed or in a flexible supplementary insulin therapy, with or without Insulin Detemir plus Metformin, if needed, in subjects with type 2 diabetes.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 Diabetes for more than 6 months
* Treatment with 1 or more oral anti-diabetic drugs or insulin, or a combination of these for more than 3 months
* Body Mass Index (BMI) less than or equal to 40 kg/m2
* HbA1c 7.0-11.0%

Exclusion Criteria:

* Treatment with short acting insulin(s) for longer than 10 days
* Current treatment with TZDs. A TZD medication must be stopped at least 14 days before the randomization
* Proliferative retinopathy or maculopathy requiring acute or laser treatment within the last 6 months
